verses.text: For the music director. Of David. I go to the LORD for safety. So how can you say to me, "Fly away like a bird to your mountain"?
Look, the wicked are bending their bows. They put their arrows on the strings to shoot from the dark at people whose hearts are honest.
When the foundations are being destroyed, what can good people do?
The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD's throne is in heaven. His eyes watch. He looks closely at all people.
The LORD tests good people, but he hates the wicked and those who love violence.
He will rain burning coals on the wicked. Fire, burning sulfur, and a scorching wind will be what they get.
The LORD always does what is right, and he loves what is right. Honest people will see his face.
